title: Empirical concentration for chains with infinite memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.32265v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Concentration inequalities for time series usually involve unknown quantities measuring dependence. This prevents their direct use as confidence bounds, or as criteria for learning algorithms. Recent works proved empirical concentration inequalities for stationary Markov chains, where the unknown quantities are estimated. We extend this approach beyond the Markov case, by considering stationary chains with infinite memory. We first establish a bounded-differences inequality on bounded Polish metric spaces under a summable Wasserstein contraction condition. We then estimate its dependence coefficients from a single trajectory, using either transition counts when the state space is finite, or derivatives of kernel conditional-density estimates for a continuous state space. We give general error bounds and illustrate their dependence on the memory tail. Finally, a fixed multiplicative safety factor turns these estimators into empirical conc

translated_title: 具有无限记忆的链的经验集中不等式
translated_abstract: 时间序列的集中不等式通常涉及衡量依赖性的未知量，这妨碍了它们直接用作置信界或学习算法的准则。近期的工作针对平稳马尔可夫链证明了经验集中不等式，其中未知量被估计出来。我们将这一方法扩展到马尔可夫情形之外，考虑具有无限记忆的平稳链。我们首先在可求和的Wasserstein压缩条件下，于有界Polish度量空间上建立了有界差分不等式。随后，我们从单条轨迹估计其依赖系数：当状态空间有限时使用转移计数，当状态空间连续时使用核条件密度估计的导数。我们给出了一般的误差界，并说明这些误差界对记忆尾部的依赖关系。最后，通过一个固定的乘法安全因子，将这些估计量转化为经验集中不等式。
tldr: 本文将经验集中不等式从马尔可夫链推广到具有无限记忆的平稳链，在Wasserstein压缩条件下建立了有界差分不等式，并仅凭单条轨迹估计依赖系数，从而得到可直接使用的经验集中界。
en_tdlr: This paper extends empirical concentration inequalities beyond Markov chains to stationary chains with infinite memory, establishing a bounded-differences inequality under a summable Wasserstein contraction condition and estimating the dependence coefficients from a single trajectory to obtain directly usable empirical concentration bounds.
